summary: The new way stops being an experiment the moment other people have to build their lives around it.
body: The new way stops being an experiment the moment other people have to build their lives around it. When Saturn conjoins Uranus, disruption and structure fuse, giving a new system, rule, habit, or boundary enough authority to replace what came before it. The change may solve a problem that genuinely needed solving, but that does not mean everyone can absorb the transition at the same speed or cost. Reinvention becomes sustainable when the replacement can carry what people still need, not simply prove that the old way is over.
